title.en: An Act Renaming the Bay-Ang Elementary School, in Barangay Bay-Ang, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, as the Beatriz D. Tupaz Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Bay-Ang Elementary School, in Barangay Bay-Ang, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, as the Beatriz D. Tupaz Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6662_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Bay-ang Elementary School in Barangay Bay-ang, Municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, is hereby changed to Beatriz D. Tupas Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
